project.title: Viral metagenome of  feces from wild birds in cities
project.description: We describe here the metagenomics-derived viral sequences found in fecal samples collected from wild birds in cities in China. Feces can be the source of numerous vial infections in animals and humans. A library was then constructed using Nextera XT DNA Sample Preparation Kit (Illumina) and then sequenced using the Miseq Illumina platform with 250 bases paired ends with a distinct molecular tag for each pool.

samples: Model organism or animal sample from Wild birds in cities
